traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and technical requirements for Story 004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS are implemented and verified: - Core Functionality: `require-branch-annotation` detects missing `@story`/`@req` on significant branch types (if/else, loops, try/catch, switch cases), with configurable branchTypes and special handling for switch default cases. - Quality & Performance: Implementation follows ESLint best practices (meta, schema, messages, fixers) and has a dedicated performance test ensuring fast analysis of large nested-branch files. - Integration: Rule is wired into the plugin’s rules export and flat-config presets, and tests confirm interaction with complex nested structures and various control flow patterns, including catch blocks and formatter-affected code. - User Experience: Error messages clearly identify missing annotation type; auto-fix behavior inserts sensible placeholder annotations at appropriate locations, particularly in catch blocks. - Error Handling: Invalid `branchTypes` configuration produces explicit configuration errors; helpers handle missing APIs and complex catch bodies gracefully without throwing. - Documentation: docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md provides usage, configuration, examples, and invalid configuration behavior tied back to this story. Given the current code and passing targeted and full test runs, the story is fully satisfied.
